recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-11034 unless a future editorial issue separately modernizes the external RFC link.
issue_request: FHIR-11034 was a Published/Persuasive non-substantive clarification asking that the core overview note 'HTTP/1.1 is strongly recommended but not required' be made clear as version guidance rather than a requirement to use literal text.
initial_application: Git commit faed34625845a03ea5b898c8c225bf6a1f501d97, matching the Jira comment's svn revision 10348, changed source/overview-dev.html from 'Note that HTTP/1.1 is strongly recommended but not required' to wording about 'use of ... HTTP v 1.1'.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes overview-dev.html as the Developer Introduction, so the checked source is in build scope. Later commit 86a07e2f5a18780ff44c6ef3daf33f0e6a85f066 updated the external HTTP spec link but preserved the version-use wording. Community searches found no relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current line at source/overview-dev.html:306 already says that use of HTTP v 1.1 is strongly recommended but not required, satisfying the issue's intent.
